title: Post by harrisonniap
description:
Pairing fonts together is a pretty cool trend nowadays, and you are probably seeing it in a lot of cinematic videos without noticing how artfully well they complement the video. Or have you? 🤔

In the world of videos (or art in general honestly), a good taste of pattern interruption both captures attention and adds to the aesthetic and mood of a video. So font-wise, an example would be putting a bold font next to a script to just make it pop more. 

These are the pairs that I feel are super versatile and can be used in any video. The trick is letting them overlap a little, AND reduce the font kerning (space between each character) so it looks more unique. That’s the secret sauce to how people really make fonts look better than how you normally see them.

Comment “FONT” and I’ll send you a free list of 20 cinematic fonts and where to grab them! ✅
